My ideal audience is [describe audience, characteristics, their interest and goals, etc]. Based on this, write down a few best-selling course ideas that my audience would be willing to pay for. Include both evergreen and even trendy topics, explain why each idea has market potential, and also identify the problems it solves. Also tell me the best course format I should create, estimated length, pricing strategy, and how I can make it stand out.
description: The Course Idea Machine
source: I Tested 200 ChatGPT Prompts.PDF

title: The No-Nonsense Editor
prompt: Act as a world-class editor with zero tolerance for weak writing. Transform my average writing into exceptional content. Critique the text I have provided with honesty. Flag weak openings, ideas that are unclear, wordy sentences, repetitive wording, passive constructions, overused expressions, weak arguments, poor word flow, and anything that slows my audience down. If possible, write any unwanted sentences using stronger language, should have smoother transitions, and even more engaging wording while keeping the original meaning. If you think my entire text should be cut, then reorganize or expand and explain reasoning and provide a better version.
description: The No-Nonsense Editor
source: I Tested 200 ChatGPT Prompts.PDF

title: The Overwhelm Eliminator
prompt: Act as an expert productivity coach and task planner. I am feeling overwhelmed by [big task]. Break it down into a clear, logical checklist of small, manageable steps, so I know exactly where to start and what to do next. Also, help me organize the tasks in a proper order, highlight any prerequisites, estimate the time required, and help me identify the highest-priority actions. If the project is large, divide it into milestones with clear objectives. Also, give me ways to simplify the process and also avoid common mistakes. Maintain momentum until the task is complete.
description: The Overwhelm Eliminator
source: I Tested 200 ChatGPT Prompts.PDF

title: The Instagram Growth Playbook
prompt: Act as an Instagram growth strategist with expertise in organic audience building. Analyze the five most effective strategies I can follow to grow my Instagram account organically in 2026. Also, provide me with each strategy, explain why it works, when to actually use it, and how exactly to implement it step by step. Include recommended posting schedules, content formats (Reels, Carousels, Stories, Lives, and Posts), hashtag strategies, keyword optimization, profile optimization, collaboration techniques, and engagement methods that maximize reach. Also give me real-world examples of successful creators or brands who are using each strategy, highlight common mistakes to avoid, and also explain which metrics should be tracked to measure long-term success.
description: The Instagram Growth Playbook
source: I Tested 200 ChatGPT Prompts.PDF

title: The Engagement Blueprint
